questions.q: Why does diamond feel “cold” to the touch?
choices: It carries heat away faster than copper

questions.q: How does the thermal tester work?
choices: A slightly heated probe measures how fast heat leaves the stone
questions.why: A diamond carries heat away quickly.

questions.q: A cubic zirconia under the thermal tester…
